description: While the project's hub is unreachable, the board header keeps saying "Saved locally · synced" (still after 25 s), although client status reports hubConnected:false and syncError "Could not reach sync server". The only cue is a small "Remote presence unavailable" label.
expected: "Saved locally · hub offline" (or similar) whenever the hub is unreachable, even with nothing pending.
suggested_fix: Derive the sync label from hubConnected/syncError, not only syncPending.

description: Creating a My device invitation on a joined (replica) computer while the hub is down gives "Project authority unavailable; retry this attempt". It doesn't say that the hub is Ben's computer or that invitations for this project are issued there. The history list also stays on "Loading…" indefinitely.
expected: "Invitations for Atlas Search Relevance are issued by Ben Carter's computer, which is offline. Try again when it's back." History shows an error state, not Loading.
actual: Generic hub-unavailable copy; history stuck on Loading….
suggested_fix: Name the hub owner in HUB_UNAVAILABLE for invitation actions; time out the history fetch into an error state.

description: Linking a device replaces the Git-prefilled identity (personal email) with the sponsor identity (work email) without first showing which identity the computer will adopt. The same gap lets another person's invitation silently take over (STORY-016).
expected: After pasting, preview 'This computer will act as Sofia Marchetti (sofia@atlas-search.com) on Atlas Search Relevance' and ask for confirmation.
actual: Link device immediately adopts the identity; the personal email silently disappears.
suggested_fix: Show the sponsor identity decoded from the invitation (or from a preflight call) before linking.

criterion: Disclosure: tell the person what they need before they need it
description: The Link this device page doesn't say where a My device invitation comes from (Invite → My device on a computer already in the project), so the person reaches the desktop's link page empty-handed and has to switch computers.
expected: One line: 'On a computer where you already use this project, choose Invite → My device and copy the invitation.'
actual: "A My device invitation from your own client adds this computer under your existing identity."
suggested_fix: Add the concrete source instruction to the Link page lead.
